guarantees.claim: Instance u_uart_rxfifo of prim_fifo_sync connects its output ports: rdata_o drives uart_rdata, rvalid_o drives rx_fifo_rvalid, wready_o drives rx_fifo_wready, depth_o drives rx_fifo_depth; .full_o and .err_o are left unconnected.

assumptions.claim: rx_fifo_wvalid and rx_fifo_data are valid 8-bit data whenever the UART reception path decides to push a byte into the FIFO.
assumptions.cond: when uart_rxfifo is enabled and not in reset/clear
assumptions.risk: Corrupted or stale data could be stored in the RX buffer, leading to incorrect received bytes.

uncertain_points.claim: The .full_o port of the RX FIFO is unconnected; the design has no way to detect when the FIFO is full.
uncertain_points.cond: while receiving data, FIFO can become full if not read fast enough
uncertain_points.risk: Writes to a full FIFO may be ignored (dependent on prim_fifo_sync implementation) causing silent data loss without back‑pressure to the UART receiver.

uncertain_points.claim: The .err_o port of the RX FIFO is unconnected; any error condition signaled by the FIFO (e.g., overflow, underflow, parity) is silently ignored.
uncertain_points.cond: when an error occurs inside the FIFO
uncertain_points.risk: A corrupted or lost data event will not be reported to the rest of the UART core, potentially masking a security‑relevant data integrity failure.
